name: File Lock
description: Cooperative locking for concurrent agents in a shared worktree. Edit/Write acquire a sibling .locked file before mutating; stale locks (dead PID, time threshold) are auto-broken. The LockStatus tool inspects locks under cwd, and a CLI is shipped for human use. Disable via `plugins["file-lock"].enabled = false` in `~/.minimal-agent/config.jsonc` or the env var `MINIMAL_AGENT_FILE_LOCK_DISABLED=1`.

tool.name: LockStatus
tool.description: Inspect or clear cooperative file locks under cwd. Use when an Edit/Write returns a 'file is locked' error and you need to understand the situation. Actions: `list` (show all locks under cwd, with holder details), `inspect` (show one lock by file_path), `clear-stale` (remove locks whose holder PID is dead or older than the stale threshold; safe), `clear` (remove a specific lock by file_path; unsafe, only when you have strong reason to believe the auto-stale-breaker missed something).

path.description: For `list`/`clear-stale`: the directory to walk (default: cwd). For `inspect`/`clear`: absolute path of the locked file, not the .locked sibling.

format.description: Output format. `text` (default) is compact ANSI for transcript reading; `json` is parseable for programmatic use.
